future_trigger: Private K–12 schoolsites definition applies December 31 2026
decision: Not an ordinary residential repair or structural pest-control obligation. Action governs pesticide use in production of an agricultural commodity near schoolsites. Preserve conditional agricultural land-use scope in CCR3; do not apply solely because residential property is near a school.
status: Final text and operative edition identified; scope exclusion is activity-specific, not an assertion that the action is unadopted.
